text:
olivia: hey team quick Q  I had a mixed trip: flew Sunday (personal), Monday-Tuesday business, left Wednesday. Took rideshares on Sunday night and Tuesday morning. Sunday was personal so I used personal card, Tuesday I used company card. Can i submit the Sunday rideshare on Expensify and get reimbursed since it's partly to/from hotel for a business meeting?
aj: short answer: reimburse only business-related travel. personal-night rides are reimbursable only if they are necessary for the business activity (e.g., getting to a site for an early meeting). need manager pre-approval + note.
rachel: nuance: if the Sunday ride was purely social or sightseeing, it's not reimbursable. If it dropped you at the hotel early for a Monday meeting, submit with explanation and manager approval. attach trip itinerary showing meeting time.
olivia: i got dropped off at hotel late Sunday because flight arrived late, meeting not until Monday 9am. Manager said it was fine but i didn't mark the travel request as including the overnight. Is manager note enough?
aj: manager approval in the travel request is ideal. If missing, manager can approve in Expensify comment when you submit. Finance may ask for the manager's approval snippet. include a short comment: "Manager approved overnight due to late arrival - see @mike confirmation in thread".
olivia: what about per-diem for Monday and partial Tuesday? do i still upload meal receipts for Tuesday morning coffee I bought before the meeting?
rachel: per-diem covers meals for full business days. For partial days, you can choose per-diem prorated or submit Actuals for specific meals. If you take per-diem for Tue, don't also submit receipts for those meals. For the coffee before meeting, submit as Actuals if it's business. otherwise let per-diem cover it.
olivia: ok. any tip on marking rideshares that spanned midnight or crossed personal/business days?
aj: write the ride date/time and purpose in receipt comment. if one ride covers both personal & business stops, allocate portion of fare and include screenshot of route with timestamps. Finance accepts reasonable allocation with manager sign-off.
finance-bot: automated note: "Rideshare allocations: attach trip route or receipt, indicate business portion as a $ amount. Missing manager approval will delay reimbursement. Rides > $150 escalate to Finance".
olivia: final Q  do reimbursed personal-night rides count as taxable fringe? we had an employee in another company told some ride reimbursements are taxable.
rachel: generally reimbursements for business travel are not taxable if they follow an accountable plan (itemized receipts, business purpose, timely submission). personal-night items that are business-approved may still be considered business travel if documentation supports it. Finance will flag if any taxable treatment is needed.
aj: TL;DR: get manager approval in travel request or Expensify comment, attach itinerary showing meeting times, prorate if needed, and pick either Per-diem or Actuals for meals on that date  not both.
olivia: great, thanks. uploading receipts and tagging @mike for approval. :white_check_mark:
